purpose: Assess data quality for the existing same-candidate entry-price gate; no profit verdict from one pilot.

proposed_schedule.rationale: One stable intraday data-quality window; times/horizon are proposed design choices, not optimized entry/exit rules.
proposed_schedule.late_decision_rule: Do not replace or drop the candidate. Report delay/maturity/unknown; current as_of and horizon checks decide evaluability.
proposed_schedule.admission_warning: Scheduler has initial 60-second wait and interval after work; first return in this window is not guaranteed.
proposed_schedule.budget_start_warning: Installation substantially before 09:55 invalidates this resource budget; runtime has no earliest-install gate.

limitations: 5000 synthetic BOOK records, 8 synthetic symbols; not a live message-rate estimate.
tracemalloc retained Python allocations are not RSS; native allocations/exports/reader/other bot components excluded.
Synthetic strings/field lengths are not a maximum record size.
One local writer run is not sustained/burst-rate or event-loop latency evidence.

notes: All callback BOOK records count, including operational symbols; max_candidates does not cap total quote volume.
25% reserve is a draft allowance, not evidence that non-quote records or the first scan fit.
The screener returns all merged ranked results; a single scan may exceed max_record_bytes.
Candidate leases follow original scan order up to 3; unallocated candidates remain in the full scan denominator.
Do not sample or discard the first quote to force capacity to fit; unsupported capacity means incomplete/no performance claim.
Phase18 adds pre-pending capital fields to order_ready. The earlier synthetic BOOK-only resource probe does not bound these larger records.

cost_contract.scope: KRX KOSPI/KOSDAQ ordinary stocks only; exclude ETF/ETN/KONEX and NXT pricing from this fee model.
cost_contract.primary_label: first-ask/first-bid price proxy, not fill evidence
cost_contract.spread_rule: Actual observed ask/bid already contains spread; do not add it again.
cost_contract.stress_rule: Report both predetermined stresses, never select a best-performing cost assumption.

capital_contract.necessary_per_candidate: Recorded pre-pending components plus identity, quantity, source/time linkage; missing or failed common-quantity guards remain unknown.
capital_contract.not_sufficient: Total capital or a pre-pending snapshot alone is not broker buying-power evidence or the all-in comparator budget. Earlier rejected candidates remain unknown.
capital_contract.quantity_rule: Use recorded requested quantity for a same-quantity diagnostic; it is not a confirmed fill.
capital_contract.pre_pending_observation_basis: engine_memory_not_broker_balance; before own reservation, not the historical inputs used by earlier gates
capital_contract.required_conversion: No scalar conversion: explicitly opt into pre-pending-guards-v1; independently enforce cash cost, market buffer, strategy notional, declared position and declared risk limits.
capital_contract.guard_failure_rule: unknown; never classify as a price-gate cash choice or avoided loss

evaluation.scope: live_screening/gap_and_go only; not all stock-selection paths or the whole engine
evaluation.a: Existing pre-transport order-ready path priced at first validly selected KRX ask.
evaluation.b: Same A input and quantity; retain the entry only when the existing cost-adjusted price gate permits it.
evaluation.exit: Same fixed-horizon first KRX bid price proxy; no actual ExitManager replay.
evaluation.denominator: All candidates in the successfully persisted first returned scan, including candidate-level failures/unallocated/unknown/out_of_scope; a successfully recorded empty scan has zero candidates.
evaluation.quality_pass: Journal integrity/no known gap plus preserved population and at least one fully supported pair; partial coverage remains explicitly partial.
evaluation.empty_or_no_ready: Inconclusive data-quality pilot; do not silently choose a later scan or change horizon.
evaluation.profit_promotion: Never promote from one pilot, one day, one positive paired delta, or partial-population results.
other_limits: No capital recycling/concurrent positions/account drawdown or actual fill simulation.
No reward for raising cash without separately showing foregone profits and market opportunity cost.
Observed target high is not a probability estimate of reaching that target.
LLM/data/server incremental costs must be evaluated before any account net-profit claim.
evaluation.benchmark: Retain full KODEX200 opportunity cost; semiconductor-excluded/version/regime views are auxiliary and require matched data.
evaluation.scan_capture_failure: If the first scan itself cannot be copied/persisted, its full denominator is unrecoverable. Mark pilot incomplete; never replace it with a later scan.
